Name: Junimo Warp
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Place yourself inside a Junimo Chest and warp to another chest.[/size]

Adds a new Warp button when interacting with Junimo Chests, allowing you to warp between all the placed Junimo Chests.
By default, the Junimo Chest has to be empty before you're able to warp, but this behavior is configurable.

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/JunimoWarp]here[/url].
